QuestInfo.name: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, could use some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
QuestInfo.1: #p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, received an important request, but he's been having trouble because he's short on materials. I'll need to defeat some #r#o15#s#k and craft #b10 #t4003000#s#k to help him out.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to deliver the items #p503# asked for without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.

0.0: Ah, just the person I wanted to see! #p511# of #m10004000# requested a special weapon for the warriors of the town. But there's no way I can finish the order in time by myself. Would you lend this old craftsman a hand?

yes.0: Much obliged! What I need are #b#t4003000#s#k. Hunt down #r#o15#s#k around #m10004000#, gather the materials, and craft 10 for me. Why something so simple, you ask? Hah! You're not giving them nearly enough credit!

no.0: Hmph... An apprentice turning down his master... Back in my day, we wouldn't even dream of such a thing.

1.0: Wonderful! Just what I needed. You really are a reliable apprentice--strong arms and a good heart, too!

yes.0: Here, take this #t2002005#. Think of it as a little boost to help sharpen your weaponcrafting skills.
yes.1: Though... this might be a problem. I feel like #p511# will keep sending requests like this my way. Looks like I'll be relying on you more often, eh? Don't wander too far!

mob.0: Didn't take down all the monsters I mentioned, did you? Come on now, move those legs!

item.0: Didn't gather all the materials, hmm? Chop-chop! A crafter's work waits for no one!
